review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped for the `LaurentK0` and `gradedSimpleClassBasis` definitions. They are library-internal and sit outside this file. I did not search Mathlib for equivalents of the graded Grothendieck group, so a duplicate there is not ruled out. This file adds none.
